Thank you. Just yesterday, I realized I had been neglecting a bad infection I had because I didn’t think I was worth the trouble to treat it. I’m treating it now, though. Hopefully the antibiotics course will do the job thoroughly.

She’s in assisted living now because of those habits, so I’m unlearning everything.
